subject: VAT on annual subscription proration + reverse-charge for EU reseller
body:
--- Message 1 (original) ---
From: Hannah Bright <hannah@brightloop.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VAT treatment for annual reseller subscription (Portugal)

Hi Soojin,

We've onboarded a reseller in Portugal who will bill their customers and then resell Redwood-powered features as part of a bundled subscription. BrightLoop is asking how Redwood will apply VAT on our annual subscription charges to BrightLoop (they are the reseller). BrightLoop expects to be VAT-registered in PT and would like the invoice to be net of VAT (reverse-charge) if possible.

Two specific asks:
- If BrightLoop provides a Portuguese VAT number, can Redwood issue an invoice without charging VAT (reverse-charge) for the EU sale to a B2B buyer?
- We had a mid-year change (proration) on the subscription when they upgraded seats — how should proration lines be shown, and does reverse-charge apply to proration credits/charges?

Thanks — want to make sure accounting is clean for both sides.

Best,
Hannah
Director, Partnerships
BrightLoop

--- Message 2 (Soojin reply) ---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Bright <hannah@brightloop.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for annual reseller subscription (Portugal)

Hi Hannah — great question. Short answer: yes, we can treat the sale to BrightLoop as an intra-EU B2B supply and issue the invoice net of VAT (reverse-charge) provided BrightLoop supplies a valid Portuguese VAT ID and we confirm their business status.

A few practical details and steps we'll take:
1) VAT ID validation: please send the VAT number and a certificate (attached in your next reply). We will validate against VIES and keep a copy in our billing record.
2) Invoice presentation: we will reissue the invoice showing two separate line items where applicable — (a) the annual subscription charge, and (b) any proration/adjustment lines. Each line will include the note: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient (Article 194 of the VAT Directive)" and the buyer VAT number.
3) Proration handling: proration charges/credits tied to seat changes are treated as part of the taxable supply period and are eligible for reverse-charge treatment, as long as the recipient is B2B and VAT-registered. We'll include clear references to the original invoice lines and pro-rated dates.
4) Self-billing / recurring: BrightLoop asked about self-billing — we can enable a self-billing arrangement next quarter once procurement signs the MSA amendment. Until then, we'll issue standard supplier invoices (net of VAT) after validation.

Ben — tagging you to confirm whether finance needs any additional supporting wording on the invoice.

Thanks,
Soojin
Commercial Contracts Lead
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 (internal advice from Ben) ---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for annual reseller subscription (Portugal)

Soojin — quick internal note.

Operational checklist for finance once VAT ID is provided:
- Validate VAT ID via VIES and save the VIES response (screenshot/PDF).
- If VIES fails, ask for national tax authority confirmation or certificate (we can accept a scanned VAT registration certificate).
- For the proration, include a negative credit line on the current invoice and a positive charge on the amendment invoice; both lines should reference the original subscription SKU and pro-rated dates.
- In Invoice metadata: include "Reverse charge — EU B2B supply — buyer VAT: PT99999999" (we'll substitute the real number).
- Do not apply local Portuguese VAT if the recipient is confirmed B2B and VAT-registered.

Attached: sample-invoice-reverse-charge-2027Q2.pdf (format to use). Also recommend a one-off credit + reissue instead of patching the historic invoice to keep audit trail clean.

Thanks,
Ben
Head of Revenue Operations

--- Message 4 (external providing VAT ID) ---
From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@acornlytics.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Bright <hannah@brightloop.io>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for annual reseller subscription (Portugal)

Hi all,

Thanks — BrightLoop here (I'm managing finance for the reseller onboarding). Our Portuguese VAT number is PT123456789. I attached a PDF export of our VAT certificate (brightloop_vat_id_v1.pdf).

A couple of follow-ups:
- We'd prefer self-billing if Redwood can support it (saves us manual processing). What info do you need to set that up?
- For the proration, we want the invoice lines to clearly state the effective service period for each charge/credit so our accounting can map to accrual periods.

If you need a formal PO or a signed amendment, say the word and we'll get it over.

Best,
Carlos
Finance Lead (BrightLoop)

--- Message 5 (Soojin final confirm + next steps) ---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@acornlytics.io>, Hannah Bright <hannah@brightloop.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for annual reseller subscription (Portugal)

Carlos / Hannah — thanks for the VAT PDF. I validated the VIES lookup (PT123456789 — Active) and uploaded a copy to our billing folder. Next steps we will take this week:

1) Invoice remediation (this week)
   - Finance will issue a credit for the original invoice and reissue a corrected invoice net of VAT with explicit reverse-charge wording. Proration lines will be shown as separate dated entries.
   - Attached is the sample invoice we will use (sample-invoice-reverse-charge-2027Q2.pdf).

2) Self-billing (next quarter)
   - We can enable self-billing; required items from BrightLoop: signed self-billing agreement (I can send a DocuSign), billing contact email, and confirm whether they want monthly consolidated self-bills or per-invoice self-bills.
   - If you want a draft agreement, I can circulate it for review — would you prefer DocuSign or a PDF to start?

3) Audit trail
   - We'll keep the VIES validation screenshot and the uploaded VAT certificate as evidence. Finance will add a note on the reissued invoice with the VIES validation timestamp.

Action items:
- Carlos/Hannah: confirm preferred cadence for self-billing (monthly consolidated / per invoice) and whether you want a DocuSign now or after the reissue.
- Ben/Finance: please proceed with credit + reissue once you have the attached certificate saved.

Marissa — looping you for visibility; no discount changes here, just invoice presentation and tax treatment.

Thanks all — happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Regards,
Soojin
Commercial Contracts Lead
Redwood Inference

--- End of thread ---
